info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Position Update Management API
info.description: The Position Update Management API allows businesses to modify existing account positions efficiently. This API facilitates updates to key details of positions, such as quantity or status, ensuring accurate account management. It serves users such as financial analysts and account managers who require real-time adjustments to accounts for optimized portfolio performance. By leveraging this API, organizations can maintain precise records and enhance their operational efficiency in managing financial assets.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific position management resource identified by its unique identifier RES-100045. Use this endpoint to modify properties such as name, description, or status of the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the specified position resource (RES-100045) in the account management system. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the position as per the requirements.
